Buizerd.wikitext:
{{Vehicle|title=The Buizerd|image1=Buizerd.png|type=Douglas DC-3|brand=Douglas Aircraft Company|year=1938|nationality=American}}

== Basic Information ==
The Buizerd is the Personal Plane of King [[Nicholas Goudhof V]]. 

It is build from an old Douglas DC-3 and is a completely bulletproof plane.

The plane is located at the airport in the region of [[Heuvelmeer]].

== Interior ==
The interior of the Buizerd Plane exists of three different sections.

=== The Cockpit ===
In the cockpit does the pilot control the plane to fly it where it desires. Directly behind the cockpit is an emergency escape hatch in case the king needs to evacuate the plane. On the other side there is a cabinet which stores preheated meals for during the flight.
[[File:Buizerd interior.png|thumb|Interior of the Buizerd]]

=== The Royal Cabin ===
The Royal Cabin is the personal room of the [[Nicholas Goudhof V|king]] onboard the Buizerd. This space contains two plush airchairs, a table and a sofa.

=== The Passenger Cabin ===
This area of the plane contains chairs for the staff and passengers of the [[Nicholas Goudhof V|king]]. This area also contains a radio communication station so the plane can stay in contact with ground personnel.

== Trivia ==

* The name Buizerd comes from the bird of prey, Buzzard.

Military.wikitext:
== The Dutch Robloxian Royal Military ==
The Dutch Robloxian Military are the defensive forces of Dutch Robloxia. The Military is used to defend the sovereignty of the nation and to maintain national order. The Military is lead by the Ministry of Defence & Justice.

== Branches ==
The Dutch Robloxian Military is split up in 4 different Branches. 

=== The Royal Army ===
The Royal Army is responsible for the defence of Dutch Robloxian soil and it's territories. They patrol military facilities and train at the parade grounds of Dutch Robloxia which is used as training area of the military.

=== The Royal Navy ===
The Royal Navy is responsible to protect the Royal Fleet and defend Dutch Robloxia on sea. They also protect the ports and trading routes of Dutch Robloxia.

=== The Royal Airforce ===
The Royal Airforce is responsible for the defence in the air. They patrol Airports and protect the Dutch Robloxian air traffic.

The Airforce also contains the 11th Airmobile Brigade who are qualified to fly planes, helicopters and other aircraft as well as working as paratroopers.

=== The Royal Military Police ===
The Royal Military Police are the Police corps of the army. Their duties are to support the standard Dutch Robloxian police corps as well defending the Dutch Robloxian borders and government facilities.

The Royal Military Police also contains the Royal Guard. These are the most Elite Troops of the country. They operate as the personal guard of the royal family and their properties and are used during ceremonies.

== Information ==

# TRIVIA: Pope is big history buff. Pope issued over 300 decrees and celebrated 200 masses up to now. Before becoming priest, pope had 3 other jobs: Train Dispacher, Doctor and Teacher Pope got many titles: ThLic. ICDr. prof. PhD. (and also MUDr. MDDr, and PaeDr., but he renounced those) Pope is holding many awards from 6 different countries: Austria, Slovakia, UK, Italy, Spain, Prussia

== History ==

* Pope Paul VII, born graf Matteo Sollanius v. Schlesien 30. april 1977 in Kysuce Hospital with Polyclinic Čadca, is 1st pope of CSV. He was raised in Rajecké Teplice in Sollanius Manor. His parents were Marquess of Schlesien and Sir Stasko from Staškov. His grandmother was Duchess of Schlesien. His grandaunt was from italian House of Carrafa. He entered Jesuit Order with priestal ordination on 4.6.2018 and eternal vows on 4.7.2018. He served as Provincial of Slovak SJ Province. After death of H.Exc. Thomas Širo, on 3.3.2020 he was ordained Bishop of Žilina. He reformed deanries and parishes of Diocese and established Silver Cross of Diosese of Žilina as highest diocesian award. After succesful episcopal synode. On consistory of 19.3.2021, he was created Cardinal of Holy Roman Church. His titular church became Chiesa S. Marcelino e Petro. After estabilishment of CSV, he was invited for initial conclave. On first ballot he got 4 votes from 5 and became Pope Paul VII. As his motto he picked: Et in terra pax hominibus! In this motto he marked his papal agenda. And as his coat he picked the coat of arms of House of Carrafa. In 2024 he published an encyclical with the name PAX VOBISCUM! about peace in the World. == Politics ==
The Kingdom of Dutch Robloxia is a Parliamentary Semi-Constitutional Monarchy. 

In Dutch Robloxia is the [[Nicholas Goudhof V|Monarch]] the Head of State and is he responsible for overseeing the Prime Minister and to maintain the democracy. 

The Head of Government is the Prime Minister. He is responsible for appointing and overseeing the cabinet. 

The Prime Minister [Parliamentary Palace, Oysterdam and Palace of Government, Hendrikdam] is elected during elections that are called upon by the people (which is allowed to be called for every month, unless the Prime Minister suddenly leaves or is being fired for violating the standard constitution).  Responsibilities: Government policy • Planning • Information • Dutch royal house • Local Goverment •  Elections 

=== Ministries ===
The Cabinet consists of several Ministeries and Ministers: 

==== Ministry of Defence & Justice [Palace of Governorate, Hendrikdam] ====
Responsibilities: Intelligence • Justice system • Law enforcement • Public security • Emergency management • Counter-terrorism • Legal aid • Drug policy • Incarcerations • Armed forces • Military policy • National security • Veterans Affairs • Military police • Defence diplomacy • Humanitarian aid 

==== Ministry of Finance [Palace of Governorate, Hendrikdam] ====
Responsibilities: Agricultural policy • Economic policy • Monetary policy • Fiscal policy • Tax policy • Incomes policy • Financial market • Regulations • Government budget • Commercial policy • Industrial policy • Investment policy • Technology policy • Mining • Trade 

==== Ministry of Social Affairs  [Palace of Governorate, Hendrikdam] ====
Responsibilities: Public administration • Civil service • Social policy • Employment • Labour economics • Occupational safety and health • Social security • Consumer protection • Trade unions • Trade associations • Emancipation

==== Ministry of Foreign Affairs [Palace of Governorate, Hendrikdam] ====
Responsibilities: Foreign relations • Foreign policy • International development • International trade • European Union • NATO • Benelux • Diaspora • Kingdom Relations

==== Ministry of Education, Culture & Science [Parliamentary Palace. Oysterdam] ====
Responsibilities: Space policy • Natural resource • Tourism • Environmental policy • Climate change policy • Renewable energy policy  •  Education policy • Cultural policy • Science policy • Knowledge policy • Research • Innovation • Art • Gender equality • Communication • Media • Forestry • Animal welfare • Food policy

==== Ministry of Housing  [Townhall, Oysterdam] ====
Responsibilities: Housing policy • Spatial planning • Public works

==== Ministry of Healthcare [Parliamentary Palace, Oysterdam] ====
Responsibilities: Health care • Health policy • Health insurance • Pharmaceutical policy • Vaccination policy • Welfare • Biomedical sciences • Sport • Food safety

==== Ministry of Migration [Townhall, Oysterdam] ====
Responsibilities: Immigration policy • Foreing Propaganda • Integrating affairs

== Regions ==
Dutch Robloxia consists of several mainland and island regions. Alot of these regions have their own regional administration. These administrations are being overseen by a Governor. A Governor controls the tax system and police forces in it's region. A governor is also required from now to then send reports on the situation in it's region to the state government.

Regions that have governors are for instance Heuvelmeer, Hendrikdam & Vaderveen.

==About==
Dutch Robloxia, Officially called the Kingdom of Dutch Robloxia, is a country on the west coast of Europe between The Netherlands and Belgium. It is a historical germanic dutch styled country ruled by a monarchy of the Goudhof Family. The country has a well-developed infrastructure and a modernized military.

Under the leadership of King Nicholas Goudhof V, the country became a very organised country build from just some soggy ground to a strong nation.

Dutch Robloxia also has various islands with hills and several kinds of vegetation.

The country has a parliamentary system where people can vote for a prime minister and on several large political decisions.

The country also supports multiple human rights such as freedom of speech, gender, religion and freedom of press.

Healthcare insurance is also largely financed by the government and the government takes care of the homeless people by building more houses and residences.

The country is also very open to alliances on political, economical and military subjects.

Vaderveen.wikitext:
{{Location|title=Vaderveen|image=Flag of the island vaderveen.png|type=Island|location=Dutch Robloxia}}

== Information ==
Vaderveen is a small Island on the West Coast of Dutch Robloxia. 

The Island is covered with beautiful forests and beaches. The Island can only be accessed by sea since there is no space on the island to land an aircraft. 

The Island lays right next to the Angel Island, which is most known for its large angel statue carved from rock.

== History ==
The Island of Vaderveen was bought by Lord Nicholas Goudhof IV in 1989 under Goudhof Enterprises. One year later in 1990, Goudhof Enterprises started the construction of Huis Theerots. In 1992 the construction on Huis Theerots was completed. In 1993 [[Jack Houtman]] was appointed overseer of Vaderveen and held this position until his death in 1998.

== Locations ==

=== Dock ===
The docks are located on the side of the Island. This is where the [[The Mosselman|Mosselman]] is docked.

=== Huis Theerots ===
Huis Theerots is a teahouse on the highest hill on the island. It is a popular tourist attraction with a restaurant, cinema and private dinning.

=== Watchtower ===
The Watchtower is a tourist attraction at the camping grounds of the island with a view on Angel Island.
